  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 5.037954 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.666667 * (1.0 + colour * 0.3), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.714286 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.599 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.6), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.555556 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 4.381 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 0.9), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.454545 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 5.05 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A) * 0.25) * 1.1177

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.922106 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.666667 * (1.0 + colour * 0.3), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.714286 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 7.6 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.6), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.555556 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 7.641 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A) * 0.288675) * 0.9141

dsp GenBell60 where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.395829 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state p4 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e4 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.666667 * (1.0 + colour * 0.3), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.714286 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 3.15 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.6), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.555556 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 5.361 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 0.9), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.454545 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 5.682 / sr))
    let e4A := select(trigger, gate * 0.333333 * (1.0 + colour * 1.2), e4 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.384615 * sr)))
    set e4 := e4A
    set p4 := fract(p4 + min(0.45, freq * 7.22 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + sinpi(p4 * 2.0) * e4A) * 0.223607) * 1.1400
